# [deno] ships a pip-installable Deno binary. yt-dlp needs a JavaScript runtime
# to solve YouTube's player challenges, and the slim image has no node, so
# without this the container extracts no audio formats even though the same
# code works on a dev machine that happens to have node on PATH.
yt-dlp[default,deno]
pydantic
# The downloader also fetches captions: YouTube serves auto-generated caption
# tracks only to non-datacenter IPs, so this has to run wherever the downloader
# runs, not in a cloud-hosted backend.
youtube-transcript-api
